task.problem: TASK-123 currently tests each supplemental block by rendering a tentative context and catching CanonicalRagContextError broadly. That exception represents both expected budget overflow and genuine evidence/render integrity failures. A supplemental block whose source cannot be canonically rendered, for example because observed_at is a naive datetime, can therefore be silently skipped and counted in omitted_evidence_blocks as if it merely did not fit the byte budget. This makes truncated=true ambiguous: downstream consumers cannot distinguish normal bounded context packing from invalid evidence that disappeared. Before any model-facing consumer is introduced, TASK-124 must restore one precise invariant: truncation means byte-budget omission only; data/render failure remains an error.
